description: Fixed-horizon statistics for a two-group conversion A/B test from counts: rates, absolute and relative difference (variant minus control), two-sided pooled two-proportion z-test p-value, Newcombe hybrid score (Wilson) confidence interval for the difference, and the sample size per group for a stated baseline rate, minimum detectable effect, alpha and power. Assumes independent groups evaluated once; no correction for peeking, sequential or multiple testing; no exact test; not a business recommendation.

confidence_level.description: Confidence level of the interval for the difference; default 0.95.

conversions.description: Visitors who converted; at most visitors.
Visitors who converted; at most visitors.

baseline_rate.description: Assumed true conversion rate of the control group.

minimum_detectable_effect.description: Signed effect to detect: target rate minus baseline when effect_type is absolute, that difference divided by the baseline when relative (0.1 means +10 %). The absolute effect must be at least 0.000001 in magnitude and the target rate strictly between 0 and 1.

name: evaluate_ab_test
title: A/B test: significance, interval and sample size
